question_text: A 20-year-old man presents to the family medicine clinic with left knee pain. He is the star running back for his college football team with a promising future in the sport. He states he injured his knee 2 days ago during the final game of the season while making a cutting move, where his foot was planted and rotated outward and his knee buckled inward. He admits to feeling a ‘pop’ and having immediate pain. He denies any locking, clicking, or giving way since the event. Physical examination reveals an antalgic gait with avoidance of active knee extension. His left knee demonstrates moderate, diffuse swelling and is very tender to palpation along the joint line. Which of the following structures is most likely damaged in this patient?
